correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 24,204 nonempty forts W (every vertex outside W has other than one neighbor in W). Power domination fails iff the initial unobserved set contains a fort: no first force can enter a fort, and any failed forcing process leaves a fort at closure. This gives (0,0,0,486) successes in sizes 0–3. Building exchanges via shared two-subset buckets and doing bitset BFS gives the stated connected TJ and TS metrics and every histogram. In particular, TS eccentricities are 54 of 7 and 432 of 8; the exact gap histogram is (9423,29808,42174,28026,7938,486), and all 162 TJ exceptions have lower bound two and distance three. Both displayed paths realize the 3 versus 8 witness. Direct enumeration of all adjacency-preserving bijections gives order 216 and the five stated orbit profiles, matching the independent check of the frozen generators. The LCF Hamiltonian-cycle-plus-chords presentation and the incidence model have all 27 edges in bijective correspondence under the supplied map.
residual_risks: Exhaustion is for this graph and minimum-cardinality intermediate states only. No statement is made for larger budgets or a family of graphs.

value.rationale: Pappus is a natural small cubic symmetric incidence graph on which to test whether edge locality disconnects minimum sensor placements or only delays them. Exact metric loss, TS centers in one orbit, and the failure of the naive Johnson distance give distinct structural benchmark facts, not just a state count or a simulation.
residual_risks: Graph-specific finite result, not a structural bound for all cubic or symmetric graphs.
